_about: The rations buff (the owner, 2026-10-26: "energy costs -30%", on top of what they do; srp-026g/docs/notes/booster-buffs.md). Rations (regeneration_booster, a booster: it works carried, as every booster, no timed effect) keep their default modification 1094 (health regeneration +15 %) and get a second one, as the Tornado energy drink has two: a new modification 1165, stamina_spending_speed_modifier (index 19, the name the exe's table 0x928448 has) -0.30, made like 1164 (the rolled energy costs -10 %, the same path and card line 116 "Energy costs") with drop_weight 0, so it never rolls; added at the end of the table. The card shows both: "Regeneration: +15%" and "Energy costs: -30%".
